name: lawson
target: Table 3, the deuterium-tritium row only for magnetic confinement: the minimum triple product and the temperature where it occurs, at Q_fuel = 1 and Q_fuel = infinity, for the uniform-profile case
note: The paper's rounded 14 keV also sits in another table row the agent read; the agent's values (13.69, 14.28) are not that number.

name: spin-glass-thresholds
target: The theoretical threshold energies E_infinity, E_2, E_1 and E_0 for the pure spherical p-spin model at p = 4, from the paper's threshold equations
note: Posted after the model's training cutoff. Closed-form thresholds, so agreement to about 1e-14 is expected when both sides are right.

name: bb-metachecks
target: The table of standard codes: for each of the five standard bivariate bicycle codes, k, the metacheck rank r_M, and the syndrome distance d_S; plus the leader histogram for the [[144,12,12]] code and the p^2 coefficient of the exact repair curve
note: Posted after the cutoff. Integers, so exact matches are expected. The 5 recalled values are code sizes k from earlier papers. The text flag is an equation label, eq:603, named after its value.

name: qaoa-large-girth
target: The table of the infinite-degree QAOA MaxCut values nu_p and the optimal parameters' energy for depths p = 1 to 8
note: Not blind: the model recited all 8 values from memory. Its 8 text and 1 typed-number flags came from an older, looser rule; the current rule leaves 1, an angle equal to 0.4726.

name: near-axis-stellarator
target: The rotational transform on axis and the related near-axis quantities the paper reports for the configurations of sections 5.1, 5.2 and 5.3
note: Miss on one quantity: the authors' code reports elongation in the plane normal to the axis; the paper's 2.52 is in the R-z plane, which the blind value matches. The 3 recalled values are the iotas.

name: analytic-mhd
target: For both solution families, the rotational transform: the uniform family's value, and the sheared family's values at the flux surfaces where the paper states or plots them; plus the force-balance residual of the explicit formulas at sample points
note: Could not run the authors' code on Windows (a dependency has no wheel and its source build ran past the limit twice). Not retried; Linux or Mac may work.

name: greedy-sampling
target: The numerical experiment for the Paley-Wiener sinc kernel on [-1, 1]: the P-greedy maximum of the power function and the covariance-eigenvalue-tail lower bound, at the measurement budgets the paper's experiment uses
note: Posted after the cutoff. At this budget the P-greedy maximum has barely moved from its start, sqrt(c/pi), so this checks the code path more than a converged result.
